items.title: Voice works only in Chrome; Firefox + Brave fail silently
items.root_cause: ASR is window.SpeechRecognition/webkitSpeechRecognition (public/buzzy/talk.html startListening). Firefox has no such API; Brave ships it but blocks the Google speech service (service-not-allowed). startListening returned silently when SR was absent, so the mic lit up and nothing happened.
items.done_when: Browser matrix probe proves capture -> transcript -> SSE audio on Chromium (Chrome, Brave) and Firefox, and a failing browser says which step failed on screen.
